I have tried out Costa Coffee in various locations across Bangalore, simply because I refused to believe there would such big a difference in the taste and quality of such a popular international coffee chain when it comes to India. It was heart breaking to find out and sink it in.

I would any day advise Cafe Coffee Day over Costa Coffee, India. The hot chocolate with whipped cream which has been my favorite at Costa during all my years abroad is a sheer disappointment in India.   I visited the place recently on its opening night. Truly amazed by the decor of the place. They have indoor as well as outdoor sitting area. Decorated with sparkling lights, the place was definitely giving a Christmas vibes.

Coming to the food and drinks, I tried food from the ala carte menu. Chef Swatantra and his team has done a fabulous job with the food.

The chakhna or better known as scotch nuts were my favourite. These babies were completely addictive. The best dish to much along with the cocktails.

We also tried the Mojito chicken pizza, the marinated chicken with olives is quite a filler.

In prawns we tried the Teppanyaki wasabi prawns, recommended by the chef himself and it was definitely worth mentioning here. You cannot miss this one. The light zing of the wasabi completely brightened the dish.

Patrani Machhi is another dish which liked a lot. Traditionally made in Parsi households, was presented in different way, they served it with Hyderabadi thiccha.

  The latest entry in the ever growing Sarjapur is Opus Food Stories. The property is tucked away from the bustle of Sarjapur Road, with little noise, almost like an island in itself. It is a humongous property with both indoor and outdoor seating area.

This place is awesome. Went there for breakfast. Firstly, the place is quiet and serene with outdoor seating. Far from the hustle bustle of Whitefield with a bit of greenery. Secondly, the breakfast. Barring the first order when the idlis were not porous and not fluffy it has been satisfying and meets the expectation. The sambhar is thick and consistent as it is supposed to be. [('Rated 5.0', 'RATED
  Been here for a lunch on a weekend and the place really lived up to the expectations.

Decor is very subtle, elegant and cafe like..

Food and the pricing is the highlight. Value for money for sure.

We ordered a mango drink which not only looked beautiful but tasted great as well.

For main course we ordered Nasi Goreng and Chicken burger.

Both were beautifully plated, absolutely delicious and value for money..

All in all must visit place'), ('Rated 5.0', "RATED
  This is best place to have pastries and cake. I love this place a lot and visited first time.

I had ordered eggless butterscotch slice cake and Blueberry Cheese Slice,both the cake slices were served freshly prepared.

Following rating I.e.

Ambience and Hygiene -5/5
Value for money - 5/5
Portion Servered and Quality of food - 5/5.

It's a heaven for continental food lover. With wide varieties of Pizza, pasta, burgers, pastries and cake.
Recommend for all the Tomato Food lovers."), ('Rated 4.0', "RATED
  Excellent ambience and polite staff and good food especially the chicken sliders are tasty. It's nice to see that they have an elaborate menu to choose from and the service is amazingly fast! Must visit if you're nearby!"), ('Rated 3.0', 'RATED
  Great ambience. Went here to try out some desserts. Tried Cheesecake and Golden Chocolate. None of them tasted that great. Overall a good place with average taste.'), ('Rated 5.0', "RATED
  Visited this place for lunch with a friend. Although the cafe is relatively small and cosy, since it wasn't too crowded, we found a place to sit immediately. We ordered Mac and Cheese, Southern Spiced Cottage Cheese Pizza, and a slice of butterscotch cake. The food was amazing as was the dessert. The staff was very courteous and friendly. They had an offer on red velvet cake. Although they forgot to process it during initial billing, they adjusted that for us later. I would really love if they had more eggless desserts since my friend being a pure vegetarian couldn't find many options! Nevertheless, great place great ambience and food! Definitely recommend."), ('Rated 1.0', 'RATED
  I have tried ice cream from coldstone it was really a great experience from the coldstone outlet in Whitefield.

I came to know that the bloomsbury was a subsidiary of the coldstone and I was extremely happy.

I decide to try out bloomsbury sadly on valentines day! I was having great expectations from the store. But I really had a terrible experience from them!

I tried two cakes, one was oreo cake and the other one was butterscotch, and both cakes where too hard! They felt like some old hard plum cake I just had the topping and left it, cudnt take another bite of the cake!


Really bad experience on valentines day! I am never going back there again! I would never suggest anyone to try it either.'), ('Rated 5.0', 'RATED

  How did I not notice this place for so long!
Such a cozy cafe with wonderfully done interiors and a friendly staff! The food is amazing..the pizza, the sizzler and the amazing desserts. We especially loved a mango and mint beverage we tried and the pizza was yum :)'), ('Rated 4.0', "RATED
  We went to Bloomsbury's on a Friday evening and something weird happened. The whole restaurant was vacant. Couldn't comprehend the reason.
Anyway, the food here is just so good. You can pick up anything and rest assured you'll have something lipsmacking. We tried the Kung Pao Chicken with Noodles, Solo Pollo Pizza, Chicken Wellington with potato mash, and number of mocktails.
Sans the slightly over-sweet drinks, everything else was really good and thoroughly enjoyable.
The decor of the place is slightly modern juxtaposed London themed. I couldn't really understand everything from the decor standpoint because it appeared somehow inconsistent. Specially the cieling lights.
All in all, we went there for good food at decent prices and that's exactly what we good. A good 4 stars. Awesome!"), ('Rated 5.0', 'RATED

  This place serves one of the best North Indian vegetarian dishes in Bangalore! It gives you the right Punjabi feel as soon as you enter this place.

For drinks, we have tried patiala lassi and buttermilk. Both the drinks are refreshing and tasty.

For starters, we have tried pyaaz pakoda and Punjabi style french fries. The French fries were really different, spicy and tasted amazing.

In main course, we have tried kadhai paneer, paneer butter masala, paneer lababdaar, pindi chole, dal makhani, chole, rajma and baigan ka bharta. None of them disappointed us.

Paranthas are really good here. Have tried khasta parantha, pudhina khasta parantha, chilly onion parantha, cheese burst parantha and aloo pyaaz parantha. The paranthas are worth the money. They serve it to you with white butter.

  Amazing and sumptuous ambience with a decent and sofisticated crowd if I may say. If you are someone who has this impression that South Indian food only means Idli and Dosa.. you will be amazed by the wide varieties of dishes and desserts they have got. This place is a bit on the expensive side but definitely worth a try.'), ('Rated 4.0', "RATED
  Visited this place on a Friday night. We actually went to windmills and because of their bad service we decided to head to oota!
The place looks so glamorous. Very well set up, extremely nice staff, well trained, service is a bit on the slower side but I guess that is because they make everything fresh.

We ordered chicken sukka, kozhi curry, neer dosa, akki roti and jowar roti. The chicken sukka was brilliant, very nicely spiced and the right amout of citrusy notes. Even the kozhi curry was good. The rotis and the neer dosas were exceptional! I somehow felt that the texture of the chicken was a little off. Maybe because it was in cold storage for a while and it wasn't fresh. That's my only complain here.

Even the papads they served were note worthy, my favourite was the onion papad. All the chutneys were yummy!

Is the food worth the price? I don't think so.
Is the experience worth the price? Maybe!"), ('Rated 4.0', 'RATED

[('Rated 4.0', "RATED
  If you are in Whitefield and crave for some delicious North Indian food head to this place. Very light ambience and amazing offers on everyday of the week will surely make your meal, a happy meal.

I came here for lunch and started my meal with few of their chats items. Among that I really loved their Palak Patta chat, it is worth a try here.

From starter menu, aatish-e-aaloo really caught my attention, so ordered and it was beautiful. From non veg, I liked their Zafrani Kebabs, it would have been tastier if chicken pieces were more tender.

In the main course, I loved the Taaftan(bread) & Kadhai Chicken combination. Even the Manglorian Sukka Chicken was good. If you don't like more gravy then you can surely try this item here. I even tried their chicken biryani. They have the avadhi style biryani here.

Finally to end my meal, I had some delicious Malpua with Rabdi & vanilla Ice cream. Overall I liked my meal here and would surely visit this again if I am around."), ('Rated 2.0', "RATED
  Just one of those places we ended up trying due to Zomato Gold, and unfortunately didn't live up to expectations.

The ambience bordered on a edge of fancy+casual seating and had a very unfinished feel to it. However, given its location in Whitefield, it was pretty crowded on a Friday afternoon. Service here was good and even as we decided to go a la carte, it didn't take much time to be served.

The food unfortunately was a huge let down. Not a single dish was remarkable and the entire experience ended up making us more hungry than we were when we entered. I'd suggest picking up on flavours to make a better impact on the palate.

Even with Zomato Gold, I found the place not worth it's price. I genuinely hope they can pick up on their quality soon."), ('Rated 4.0', 'RATED

  I have been to this place couple of times now. Found it OK in terms of food, service, ambience, pricing and availability of drinks.

  This place started out as a boulangerie for expats serving excellent baguettes and bread. Today, they serve Bangalore some of its best pizza. The menu doesn't change. The salad doesn't change.   It was about time that our inner Bengali cravings would kick in, and after a day or so in Bangalore we thought of sticking to our home turf. We ordered from Petuk via Swiggy.

We ordered:
Veg Meal: Standard portion of rice served with Lentil, Mix Veg, and Aloo Posto. A handful amount of Bhaaji was also there and Bengali styled Chutney to end the meal on a "Tok-Mishti" note.

Fish Meal: The vegetables and lentil remained the same, the only difference being Sorshe Kaatla. The fish was fresh, and the piece was huge as well. Expected the gravy to be a bit thicker.

Chicken Meal: In place of Fish you will get Kosha Chicken, which was a bit spicy.

Overall, Petuk is affordable and their packaging is safe and tight as well.'), ('Rated 2.0', 'RATED
